Meta.title: ERVAIS | Umushoferi wa taxi i Kigali
Meta.description: Saba ERVAIS, umushoferi wa taxi w'umwuga i Kigali mu Rwanda, kugutwara. Ku kibuga cy'indege, mu mujyi, hanze ya Kigali no mu ngendo z'ubukerarugendo.

Home.intro: ERVAIS ni umushoferi wa taxi w'umwuga w'i Kigali. Uransaba, nkuhamagara cyangwa nkakwandikira kuri WhatsApp, tukumvikana, hanyuma nkaza kugutwara.

airport.name: Kujyana no kuzana ku kibuga cy'indege
airport.description: Kugutwara no kukuzana ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cya Kigali.

city.name: Ingendo mu mujyi wa Kigali
city.description: Ingendo hose muri Kigali, ku kazi, mu mirimo cyangwa nijoro.

outside.name: Ingendo hanze ya Kigali
outside.description: Ingendo z'umunsi umwe n'izirenze mu Rwanda.

tours.name: Ingendo z'ubukerarugendo
tours.description: Gusura Kigali n'ahandi, ugendeye ku kigero cyawe.

corporate.name: Ibigo n'ingendo zihoraho
corporate.description: Ingendo zihoraho z'abakozi n'abashyitsi, zitegurwa mbere.

HowItWorks.step2: ERVAIS aguhamagara cyangwa akakwandikira kuri WhatsApp.
HowItWorks.step3: Mwumvikane ku bisobanuro maze ugende neza.

About.title: Ibyerekeye <accent>ERVAIS</accent>
About.bio: Ndi ERVAIS, umushoferi wa taxi w'umwuga i Kigali. Waba ugeze ku kibuga cy'indege, ugenda mu mujyi cyangwa ujya hanze ya Kigali, tuvugana kandi tukumvikana ku bisobanuro mbere y'urugendo.
About.areas: Kigali no mu ngendo hirya no hino mu Rwanda

CtaBand.title: Witeguye kugenda?
CtaBand.text: Ohereza ubusabe, ERVAIS azaguhamagara kugira ngo mwemeranye ku bisobanuro n'igiciro. Nta kwishyura kuri interineti bikenewe.

Footer.brandBlurb: Umushoferi wa taxi wihariye i Kigali. Ku kibuga cy'indege, mu mujyi, hanze ya Kigali no mu ngendo z'ubukerarugendo.
